rules.title: San Francisco security deposit interest requirement (4.2% for 3/1/2026–2/28/2027)
rules.requirement: San Francisco landlords must pay tenants interest on security deposits. The rate is 4.2% for March 1, 2026 through February 28, 2027 (5.0% for 2025–26 and 5.2% for 2024–25).
rules.coverage_conditions: Security deposits on San Francisco residential rentals. The source does not describe any building-level coverage limits.
rules.reason: There is only one candidate, the official rate page for Admin. Code ch. 49. The effective date is left null because 2026-03-01 is an annual rate adjustment, not the date the interest requirement began.
